reviews.comment: Class is not so hard. However, this professor is no help. The TAs do everything, and the professor is no help when going to him. The TAs will also grade your exam, and they do a Friday recap lecture. I recommend going to those, because the professor rambles on in lecture. I got the highest grade in my section on the final, all from TA lectures.

I would not recommend this professor. I'm the kind of student who generally gets all A's, a few B's, and I was fighting tooth and nail to even pass this class - it was a blessing I did. He is not a good professor, wrote his own textbook, and is no help. I'm pretty sure the average for the final was a 56... I HAD to take him and I'm traumatized

It is a tough class. Remember, a lot of reviews from people you see on here are coping. If you read the textbook, went to class, and did the homework, you can get an A. Is he the best professor ever? No. But definitely nowhere the worst. Sorry kids, just because it is not an easy A doesn't mean he's a 1.0.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely if I could give him a 0 I would. This class left my GPA and my mental health in shambles. I am an A student and came out of this class with a C. Just simply do not take this professor for this class. You will regret it and your GPA will too.

his textbook is actually the worst thing to read, it is literally just words and he doesn't share the slides. do not take if you don't go to class

reviews.comment: Professor Kellstedt likes to talk about random things sometimes, but overall, he knows what he's talking about. If you read the textbook A LOT and go to the lectures, you should be fine. MAKE SURE YOU KNOW YOUR DEFINITIONS THAT ARE AT THE END OF EACH CHAPTER OF THE TEXTBOOK!!!

reviews.comment: Kellstedt made me want to blow my brains out. Lectures are about how good he wrote his own book even though his book only needs to be 1/4 of the length that it is. I thought that I had a decent understanding of statistics prior to this class, but then he taught it. He contradicted the textbook that HE WROTE multiple times, was condescending to anyone who asked questions, and was just a bad lecturer.
Now that this class is over, I can finally enjoy my life.
